owner_decision_reason: Passed thinly: +0.035130 R over 111 trades, a third of the walk-forward's estimate; profit factor 1.10 with the average loss larger than the average win, so the edge is a 54.1% win rate; max drawdown 8.80 R against 5.44 R made; crosses zero at USD 25,000 against an account under 10,000. Not frozen: a premise on paper whose edge the account cannot fund proves nothing. Revised as a new experiment; the holdout stays spent and this series is development data from here (ADR-0014).
